prompts: Use case: product-mockup. Website educational robotics project card images. Create one LANDSCAPE contact sheet of EXACTLY EIGHT distinct miniature assembled project scenes, in strict FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS equal rectangular cells. Each scene entirely inside its own cell with generous 12 percent margins. No scene crosses cell boundaries. All cells share a very pale icy blue background, studio tabletop, soft shadows, realistic polished 3D isometric render, navy blue controller boards, bright component accents. Show physical assembled hardware and neat jumper-wire connections as engaging educational prototypes. No labels, no captions, no watermarks, no graphic dividers. Display digits may appear naturally on actual hardware. Row 1 left to right then row 2 left to right: LED Traffic Light: three red amber green LEDs on a miniature traffic pole with breadboard and blue microcontroller; Plant Soil Moisture Sensor: plant pot with two-prong soil probe and blue microcontroller; Laser Tripwire Alarm: laser diode sending red beam toward sensor with buzzer; Sweeping Radar: twin-cylinder ultrasonic sensor on blue servo beside microcontroller; Automatic Night Light: white lamp with light sensor on breadboard; Auto Plant Waterer: plant pot with tiny water pump clear tube water reservoir and soil probe; Mood Lamp: glowing RGB frosted dome connected to microcontroller; Motion-Activated Hallway Light: miniature hallway with white lamp PIR dome sensor and controller. Each cell contains only its specified project. Landscape wide composition.
